Caring for your precision instruments

By J. Reyes.

A precision caliper stays accurate for years with a little care: keep it clean, store it in its case, and have it recalibrated periodically against a reference standard.

Storage

Always return the caliper to its fitted case after use to protect the jaws from knocks.
